notes: All 11 text files are Common Crawl captures; sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp date. Columbia dissertations ?year=2014: the page prints "Name, 2014" under a Dissertations year selector without saying whether 2014 is the dissertation, defense or degree year, so yearMeaning is "unstated"; the integrator may treat it as the dissertation year. Per-person department is not given (program recorded as "Doctoral Program"); degree is not written per person and left null. The 2015-08-31 capture lists 10 people; the 2016-09-29 capture lists 9 (Yonatan Gur, advisors Omar Besbes and Assaf Zeevi, is absent from the later capture). Columbia job market: the 2015-09-01 capture heads the list "2014-15 Job Market Candidates" (recorded as listedYear 2015, job-market) and the 2016-09-26 capture heads the identical list of 10 names "2016 Job Market Candidates" (recorded as 2016). Same ten people under both headings; the 2016 heading may be a stale relabel, so the integrator should double check which season each candidate actually went on the market. Operations-relevant candidates: Daniela Saban and Hua Zheng (Decision, Risk, and Operations). HEC Paris: seasons written as ranges ("2014-2015 JOB MARKET SEASON", "2013-2014 job market season", "2012-2013 job market season") recorded with the closing year and the range quoted in note. The page says it lists first academic placements of job market candidates and PhD graduates; destination copied verbatim, with "(post-doc)" also recorded as position where the page marks it. Name "Lionel Paoella" kept as written. The "Earlier Placements" section names institutions only, no people, so nothing was recorded from it. Operations Management entries: Timofey Shalpegin (University of Auckland, 2014-2015) and Mahyar Eftekhar (W.P. Carey School of Business Arizona State University, 2012-2013). ISB: one FPM job-market candidate (Arkaja Chakraverty, Financial Economics), no year on page; listedYear null with yearMeaning "job-market" describing the list type. Not an operations candidate. Email omitted. MIT Sloan: seven job-market candidates with no year on page (capture 2016-09-26); listedYear null, yearMeaning "job-market". Program recorded as the Research Group named on the page. Operations Management candidate: Leon Valdes Saavedra (advisor Karen Zheng). Email omitted. Technion: the page is an advisor thesis list (Rubinovitz Jacob) mixing MSc and PhD rows with the degree given per row, so only the two PhD rows (Boris Shnits 2006, Yosef Bukchin 1995) are recorded; the 17 MSc rows are skipped. Content is identical across the four captures apart from row order and the "Last updated" footer.
